400 Bad Request for reranking with invalid model

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import RerankRequest
from liter_llm import Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = RerankRequest.from_json("{\"documents\":[\"doc1\"],\"model\":\"nonexistent-rerank\",\"query\":\"test\"}")
        await client.rerank(request)
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
